verdict.rationale: MoonPay offers headless APIs/SDKs (build-your-own on-ramp, quote and session endpoints) and a dedicated test mode with testnets/simulated payments that could be scripted in a CI pipeline, but there is no evidence of a CLI, automation-first tooling, or documentation describing running MoonPay flows unattended in CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance, evidence of non-interactive KYC/payment flows, and independent confirmation of headless test-mode usage in pipelines.
